source: Original Blender procedural model and twenty-bone continuous weights

actualVisualReview.finding: V17 keeps the round mint/cream silhouette with a broad heart tail, soft body-painted blush, surface-following teal gill strokes and a glTF-compatible twenty-bone rig. Runtime applies a fixed ~40-degree three-quarter camera bias for readable eyes and fins; raised cheek-glaze meshes remain hidden in the runtime to avoid a sticker look. The standalone views remain true 3-D geometry; the runtime contour hull is applied only in Three.js and does not write depth.

integrationContract.update: update(frame, currentCamera) after world.update and applyCamera
integrationContract.optionalCamera: When supplied, face uses a continuous fixed ~40-degree three-quarter bias (under .70 rad) from the active camera; update(frame) remains compatible and uses original locomotion heading without wrapped-clamp jumps.
integrationContract.EyeReference: Real centre-pole midpoint of EyeIrisL/EyeIrisR; not maximum-z bounding poles. Precisely anchored to local(0,1.55,0) after skeletal pose.

limits: Standalone static preview and meaningful numeric rig checks only. Integrated world lighting, occlusion and final-film playback remain parent review duties.
Four rendered swim poses do not constitute every-frame visual or normal-speed animation review.
